description: Use when reasoning about SolidJS reactivity, debugging tracking issues, or understanding why components run once. Prevents React mental model contamination such as expecting re-renders, virtual DOM diffing, or stale closure patterns. Covers reactive dependency graph, tracking contexts, ownership tree, synchronous execution model, and direct DOM updates. Keywords: SolidJS reactivity, fine-grained, signals, tracking scope, ownership, createEffect, createMemo, no virtual DOM.
